title: The Constitutional Court, 2010–2013
grammar: Recap: obligation in the past with köteles volt and kénytelen volt
goal: I can describe the changes to the Constitutional Court's powers between 2010 and 2013, with their dates (*hatáskör, alkotmányjogi panasz, actio popularis*).
I can say what a rule required in the past with *köteles volt* and *kénytelen volt* (*a panaszos köteles volt kimeríteni a jogorvoslatokat*).
I can report how the government and its critics judged these changes.
